rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is almost, but not quite, the case.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gei1 fu4 gon2 m4 cit3 baan1 ce1

rows.note: Use this when something counts as true or functions that way in practice, even if it is not technically or formally true.

example.english: Ming is virtually the captain of this team, although he has not been formally appointed.
example.traditional: 阿明基本上係呢隊嘅隊長，雖然仲未正式任命。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 gei1 bun2 soeng6 hai6 ne1 deoi6 ge3 deoi6 zoeng2 seoi1 jin4 zung6 mei6 zing3 sik1 jam6 ming6
